Maadhav V H — ai / ml engineer · on-device ai

Machine-learning engineer. I make models small enough, and honest enough, to live on the hardware they were meant for.

Coimbatore, India
ECE, class of 2028

Phone NPUs, Arm boards, a single MI300X, a car's own signals. I like the problems where the hardware says no and you find a way anyway.

Most of my work is measurement: building the benchmark first, deciding in advance what would count as a win, and saying so plainly when something doesn't hold up.

Selected work

7 works · 4 public

  1. No. 01

    DriftSense

    runner-up · SEMICON India 2026

    Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation — or says the pattern isn’t there.

    My role: team lead

    match F1 0.91 on 2,250 pairs · CAD-to-SEM within 1 px on 600

    Read the case studypublic code ↗

  2. No. 02

    CoronarySafe

    preprint · pre-registered

    Label-free quality control for AI coronary-artery reconstructions from CT angiography: ranks scans so a reviewer checking a fixed 20% catches the critical failures that Dice hides.

    sealed test, unseen segmenter: 29 of 64 critical failures in 32 of 160 reviews (best rule: 25) · normalised recall 0.906 · pre-registered

    Preprint ↗public code ↗

  3. No. 03

    AortaMix

    open dataset · CC BY 4.0

    To our knowledge the first public simulation dataset of blood mixing in the aorta during peripheral VA-ECMO: adults at 50, 75 and 90% support, plus a child with a neck cannula. Research simulations of an idealized aorta, not for clinical use.

    3D spectral-element CFD (nekRS on an AMD MI300X) + 6,011 lumped-model samples · interactive viewer · short runs: the mixing zone had not settled at high support

    viewer ↗2-page report ↗dataset ↗

  4. No. 04

    redline

    release 1 · AMD MI300X

    A batch-1 inference engine for one model on one GPU: Qwen3.8-27B on an AMD MI300X, Rust host and hand-written HIP kernels, no PyTorch at runtime.

    My role: co-developer (2-person team)

    1k-token prompts: 5.56 ms/token vs vLLM 6.98 and SGLang 6.67 · exact mode: speculation gives the same tokens as plain decoding

    public code ↗

II.

On the easel

8 in progress

  • Rakshak-Edge

    Catches scam SMS and links on an Arm device, offline — and refuses explanations it can’t back up.

    system v1 frozen · phase 1 due 23 nov 2026 · Arm × Bharat AI-SoC · team lead

    code private until phase 1

  • Nitō

    A measurement-driven code optimizer for one exact chip: it measures what each instruction costs on a hybrid CPU’s fast and dense cores, then searches for the fastest machine code for each.

    phase 0 done · per-core instruction cost table · Rust · Ryzen AI 7 350 (Zen 5 + Zen 5c)

    code private

  • Interfacial Heat Transport Prediction

    A model for how well heat crosses the boundary between two solids, which has to beat the standard mismatch models on interfaces it has never seen.

    benchmark · physics baseline vs ML on leave-one-material-out splits · Discovered Materials Grand Challenge

    code private

  • Low-Cost Axial-Flow Ventricular Assist Device

    A cheap, magnetically coupled axial-flow blood pump with a see-through housing, so clots can be seen forming. A benchtop research prototype, built with a mechanical engineering student and a doctor as clinical advisor.

    phase 0 · CAD + CFD · water and blood-analogue tests only

    code private

  • One-Pass Neural Network Repair

    Can a small network look at a corrupted, pruned or forgetful model and predict the weight patch that fixes it, with no retraining?

    phase 0 done · tuned baselines set the bar · next: one-pass patch predictor

    code private

  • Adaptive Recurrent Depth in Looped LLMs

    Which questions an extra recurrent loop fixes, leaves alone or breaks in looped language models, and whether that can be predicted when the data shifts.

    setup · Ouro-1.4B · GSM8K → MATH-500 / BBH / GPQA

    code private

  • LLM Quantization & Inference Lab

    Hands-on quantization and serving experiments, starting with FP8 inference for a 27B Qwen model.

    learning log

    public code ↗

  • Axiom Trace

    A tutor that knows what you know: knowledge-graph RAG with mastery tracking and animated ECE explanations.

    personal project · solo · Next.js web + Kotlin app

    code private for now
